decisions.quote:
To conclude, the results of Ideal L2 Self/Own in the second layer agree with those of
              Papi and Khajavy (2021); however, the predictive power of ought selves did not show
              the same consistency.
decisions.reason: Although the abstract notes that the findings predominantly reinforce the role of regulatory focus, the authors explicitly report partial alignment across the structural model layers, with several hypothesized paths (such as from ought selves to emotions and from L2 selves to strategic inclinations) diverging in direction or significance from Papi and Khajavy (2021).
